The LLTO coated NCM materials exhibited improved rate capability, and the cycling performance also drastically improved when cycled at 0.5C. The pristine NCM only retained 56.6% of its initial discharge capacity after 200 cycles, whereas the LLTO coated NCM retained about 85.5%, 57.2% and 86.2% for LLTO-0.5, LLTO-1 and LLTO-2 respectively.

The 2 mol.% coating lowered the rate capability, which may be due to the increase in the thickness of the coating layer, resulting in the suppression of electron transfer process during charge/discharge cycling.
